shortDescription: Manages members in a device group

options.name: device_group
options.description: The device group to which you want to add the member.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the device that you want to add to the device group. Often this will be the hostname of the device. This member must be trusted by the device already. Trusting can be done with the C(bigip_device_trust) module and the C(peer_hostname) option to that module.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the device group member exists. When C(absent), ensures the device group member is removed.
